_note: Derived from audio/experiments/sweep (n=1 per setting, seed-noise floor from 4 seeds). Only exaggeration moved delivery beyond noise (0.8+ doubled pitch range but lengthened speech ~25% and was unstable on the 2nd sentence), so intents differ by exaggeration (capped 0.75), plus post-hoc tempo (ffmpeg atempo, NOT a model control) and designed pauses. cfg_weight/temperature/min_p changes were within noise; repetition_penalty 1.2 truncated output to 1.6 s (never go below 2.0). v2: first directed render (v1) ran 2.55 words/s vs the existing 3.53 (too slow for short-form), so a global_tempo of 1.06 is applied (existing pipeline uses atempo 1.08) and pauses were shortened.

voice_profile.name: kathaaya-narrator-v1
voice_profile.note: Contrast design: fast/louder on action (hook, tense, punch), slower/softer on awe/reflective, so energy comes from dynamics instead of one flat pace. Whether it sounds better is a listening judgement; metrics only confirm it did what was specified.
